newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auction's six-month short term bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auction's six-month short term bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Wednesday it had auctioned six-month maturity, short term federal investment bonds worth 3.32 billion rupees, at a weighted average yield of 15.10069 percent per annum.
The auction will be settled on Thursday, the bank said.
The bank had set a pre-auction target of 9.526 billion rupees but it received bids worth a total of 8.98 billion rupees, out of which 3.32 billion rupees were accepted.
In the previous auction held on November 5, bids worth 5.544 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 15.3594 percent per annum, against a pre-auction target of 12 billion rupees.
